howToBuy.heading: How to reserve
howToBuy.body: Tickets are limited and tables sell out early. Reserve by WhatsApp, phone or email — our team will confirm your seats and payment details personally.

items.question: What is included in a ticket?
items.answer: Every ticket includes the dinner, the red carpet, live performances, the awards ceremony and the photo experience. Table tiers add premium placement, dining and drinks as listed.

items.question: Can I buy a table for my organisation?
items.answer: Yes. Tables seat ten and are ideal for businesses, churches, associations and families. Ask us about recognition for your organisation on the night.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Formal traditional attire is encouraged — the red carpet celebrates the style of the diaspora. Black tie is also welcome.

items.question: Where does the money go?
items.answer: Proceeds support the community programs of the Canadian and African Women Aid Program (CAWAP), a Brampton non-profit.

items.question: Can I contribute without attending?
items.answer: Absolutely. Contact us to make a contribution or to sponsor an honouree's seat.
